name: lemeng.retail_order_line.foreach.v2
_note: retail_order_line **v2 扇出形态（draft，未进调度、未替换 day 形）**。
code.sql 生成 1..96 页码 → ctl.foreach（concurrency=2）逐页跑 lemeng.retail_order_line.page.v2 →
每页直接落 chunk=<page>.parquet → 父管线汇总页收据做零行/缺页/容量判据。
与 day 形的差别：106 节点 → 8 节点；单页失败**不回滚**已落盘的 chunk（但整批仍会中止，见下）；
判据从「第 96 页必须为空」升级为「页数到齐 + 总单数区间 + 第 96 页为空」。
⚠️ 0.7.4 的 ctl.foreach inline 实测：① concurrency 生效（但网关并发闸 ≤3，c=4 即 429 PAT并发请求超限）；
② continueOnFailure 只让 foreach 软失败（下游守卫照跑），**不**继续剩余 item——失败页之后的页当轮不跑；
③ retryAttempts/retryBackoffMs 是 **stage 级整体重跑**（不是逐项），重试耗尽后本环境实测卡死（>3min 无结束）。
逐页重试由子管线 src.rest 的 retryAttempts=3 承担；要逐项失败隔离需引擎支持（本版不满足）。

properties.sql:
-- 页码清单：1..96（沿用 day 形的容量上限；第 96 页必须为空 = 未截断）
SELECT
  CAST(t.p AS INTEGER) AS page_no,
  CAST(t.p AS INTEGER) AS chunk_no,
  CAST('${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
  CAST('${BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  '${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}' AS branch_nums,
  '${ENV:ZOS_BUCKET}' AS bucket,
  '${ENV:ZOS_REGION}' AS region,
  '${V2_SINK_ROOT}' AS sink_root,
  replace(replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_',''),':','') AS run_token,
  'retail-v2-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-' || CAST('${BIZDAY}' AS VARCHAR) || '-' ||
    replace(replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_',''),':','') AS batch_id,
  CAST(96 AS INTEGER) AS expected_pages,
  CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS ref_min_orders,
  CAST(19200 AS BIGINT) AS ref_max_orders,
  'p' || lpad(CAST(t.p AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS item_key
FROM range(1, 97) t(p)

SELECT p.expected_pages,
       p.ref_min_orders,
       p.ref_max_orders,
       CAST(count(r.page_no) AS INTEGER) AS pages_reported,
       CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN r.status = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS pages_ok,
       CAST(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN r.status <> 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS pages_failed,
       CAST(coalesce(sum(r.orders), 0) AS BIGINT) AS total_orders,
       CAST(coalesce(sum(r.detail_rows), 0) AS BIGINT) AS total_detail_rows,
       CAST(coalesce(max(CASE WHEN r.page_no = p.expected_pages THEN r.orders END), 0) AS BIGINT) AS last_page_orders
FROM (SELECT any_value(expected_pages) AS expected_pages,
             any_value(ref_min_orders) AS ref_min_orders,
             any_value(ref_max_orders) AS ref_max_orders FROM input) p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM read_csv('/workspace/logs/retail-v2-foreach/' ||
    replace(replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_',''),':','') || '-p*.csv',
    header = true, union_by_name = true)) r ON true
GROUP BY p.expected_pages, p.ref_min_orders, p.ref_max_orders

data.label: 零行 / 缺页 / 容量 判据

properties.sql:
SELECT 'pages_missing' AS violation,
       CAST(pages_reported AS VARCHAR) AS detail,
       CAST(expected_pages AS VARCHAR) AS expected
FROM input WHERE pages_reported <> expected_pages
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pages_failed', CAST(pages_failed AS VARCHAR), '0'
FROM input WHERE pages_failed > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'batch_empty', CAST(total_orders AS VARCHAR), '> 0'
FROM input WHERE total_orders = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'capacity_truncated', CAST(last_page_orders AS VARCHAR), '0'
FROM input WHERE last_page_orders > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_out_of_range', CAST(total_orders AS VARCHAR),
       CAST(ref_min_orders AS VARCHAR) || '..' || CAST(ref_max_orders AS VARCHAR)
FROM input WHERE total_orders < ref_min_orders OR total_orders > ref_max_orders

SELECT strftime(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS ts,
       '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
       CAST('${BIZDAY}' AS VARCHAR) AS bizday,
       '${V2_SINK_ROOT}' AS sink_root,
       *
FROM input

properties.message: retail_order_line v2 判据未过（{rows} 条违规，明细见 rep CSV / 节点输出）：pages_missing=缺页（detail=实到 / expected=应到）；pages_failed=有页失败；batch_empty=整批 0 单；capacity_truncated=第 96 页仍有单（容量截断）；orders_out_of_range=总单数越界。已落盘的 chunk 保留，补跑只补缺页。
